source.title: Social Welfare (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 2024 s.3 (as enacted)
source.note: As enacted. The Table fixes the Class A and Class S rates on 1 October in each of 2024 to 2028 (s.3(1)-(5)).

provisions.heading: Amendment of certain provisions of Principal Act relevant to employment contributions
provisions.relevanceReason: Payroll: the Class A and Class S rate substitutions (SWMPA 2024 s.3).
